scope: R-008 candidate D: full OEM stack retained; three gates prove DisplayDxe is never dispatched

reasoning.no_gate_fired: a fired gate resets 2 s after DisplayDxe returns; a missed gate waits for the end of CoreDispatcher and then the 7 s completion fallback. The three return times (31.9 / 30.9 / 33.1 s) are indistinguishable from each other, so none of the three gates fired
reasoning.detail13_matters_most: detail 13 fires on any StartImage return regardless of status, so a missing hit there cannot be explained by DisplayDxe failing; it means CoreStartImage was never reached for this GUID at all
reasoning.conclusion: DisplayDxe is never dispatched on this device

why_not_dispatched.depex: the vendor DisplayDxe.depex is eight protocol GUIDs ANDed together, ending with one END: 157a5c45-21b2-43c5-ba7c-822fee5fe599, b0760469-970c-487a-a4b5-28db7b45cef1, 5bef7c41-a560-435b-835b-3c3ebf2bd151, c1bff82d-6c92-48fb-8355-c7fb4218a4ea, a966cc4f-ee6c-424d-a762-8ed3b5a4a501, 47861dff-556f-4269-9b28-062ec3ecb30d, ad9aec18-7bf0-4809-9e96-3012309f3df7, b27ae8b1-3e10-4d07-ab5c-eb9a6dc6fa8f
why_not_dispatched.identified_so_far: 157a5c45 is the Qualcomm EFI_PLATFORMINFO protocol (PlatformInfoDxeDriver is present); b0760469 appears in QcomPkg.dec; the remaining six are not defined anywhere in the bundled source and presumably come from OEM protocol installers
why_not_dispatched.supply_gap: the 33 bundled OEM drivers are CPR, ChipInfo, Cipher, Clock, CmdDb, DALSys, DALTLMM, DDRInfo, Display, Env, Gpi, HALIOMMU, HWIO, Hash, I2C, Mac, Npa, Pdc, PlatformInfo, Pmic, PwrUtils, ResetRuntime, Rng, Rpmh, SPI, SPMI, Scm, ShmBridge, Smem, Tz, UFS, ULog, Vcs. There is no MDSS, MDP, DSI or panel driver among them, so the protocols a display stack would normally publish are absent
why_not_dispatched.status: strong inference, not yet proven by enumerating installed protocol handles

what_this_means: candidate D cannot work by simply keeping DisplayDxe: the driver is dead weight in this firmware because its dependency set is never satisfied. Keeping the OEM binaries without the OEM protocol providers changes nothing, which is why the panel stayed dark and why all three gates missed.
next_options: D1: extract and bundle the missing protocol providers (MDSS/MDP/DSI class) from this device's XBL, then re-test the same three gates
B: power MMCX/dispcc/MDSS from firmware directly, no OEM dependency
C1: UART observation channel, no display access at all
pixel_access: vendor driver only, and it never ran
mmio_writes: vendor driver only, and it never ran
interpretation: 三门(成功/失败/任意返回)返回时间无差异,均未命中,证明DisplayDxe从未被CoreStartImage;其DEpex要求8个protocol全AND,而33个OEM驱动中无MDSS/MDP/DSI类硬件驱动,依赖无法满足。故候选D不能靠'保留DisplayDxe'实现上电,须补齐protocol提供者(D1)或改走B/C1。
